verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs state it provides official SDK clients in Python and TypeScript, with a documented `pip install mistralai` install and a first-API-request quickstart, so developers can clearly build against first-party SDKs. Other languages rely on third-party, non-official SDKs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, official SDKs beyond Python/TypeScript, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404).
